messages:
tia: Quick bring-up summary for Nectar12B quant sweep — sharing highlights and a short recommendation for GTN/product.
andre: thanks. short TL;DR?
tia: TL;DR: int8 gives ~25% infra cost savings vs fp16 with ~1% aggregate QA EM hit; int4 gives ~55% savings but 3-4% EM hit and worse p99. Recommend int8 as default + a simple complexity-based pin to fp16.
sylvia: numbers? latency/throughput + cost per 1k tokens please.
tia: perf (r5g-xlarge sim): p95 single-token fp16 30ms, int8 36ms, int4 65ms. throughput (8 conc): fp16 400 tok/s, int8 540, int4 950. token infra cost/1k: fp16 $0.022, int8 $0.016, int4 $0.010.
andre: quality slices? any failure patterns?
tia: slices: quick-answer, abstractive-sum, multi-turn QA. int8 avg: -0.9% EM, -0.6 ROUGE. int4 avg: -3.9% EM, -3.1 ROUGE. int4 failure modes: truncated tails on >1k summaries, entity swaps in multi-turn, occasional date hallucination.
sylvia: interesting. What about tail latency / cold-starts?
tia: p99: fp16 68ms, int8 95ms, int4 190ms. Noticed cold kv warmup for int4 adds ~2-4x latency for first 3 tokens. Ops note: prefill=24 mitigates.
ops-bot: Bench artifacts -> s3://bench/nectar12b/3467899999/; eval csv attached.
andre: routing idea?
tia: simple policy: default int8; pin to fp16 when (prompt_len>800) OR (entity_density>0.1) OR (conversation_depth>3). Int4 only as opt-in burst pool or for very short assistant replies (<64 tokens) where recall penalty is acceptable.
sylvia: GTN copy? I can draft: "Nectar12B on Redwood: int8 recommended for production; int4 for experimental cost-savings. Hybrid routing recipe included."
andre: rollout plan?
tia: canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% for int8 default + routing. Monitor per-slice EM and p99. Rollback if per-slice EM drop >1% or sustained p99 regression >60%.
sylvia: ops actions?
tia: add kernel-fallback alerts for seq_len > 2048, include kv-warmup metric in traces, reserve +12% memory headroom for int4 burst pools. Document known failure modes in scorecard.
andre: I'll open tickets for canary automation and alerts. sylvia: I'll draft GTN scorecard + customer note. tia: thanks, will upload a short runbook and link artifacts. :rocket:
